messages:
simon: deploy-bot just flagged a canary p95 spike and error-rate breach (4.2% > 3%) across usw2. Auto-rollback is configured but currently suppressed for dedicated traffic. do we let the bot act or do a manual unwind?

deploy-bot: autopilot note: auto-rollback suppressed for dedicated customers. current window: 7m @ 4.2% error_rate. recommendation: manual rollback to v2.14.1 if team wants controlled cutover. suggested command: `/deploy rollback --to v2.14.1 --region=usw2`
rachel: @simon +1 for manual. we should avoid double flips. plan if manual: 1) initiate rollback to v2.14.1 pinned for 10m, 2) run smoke/health checks (p95, error_rate, kv_hit), 3) customer/partner note. i'll draft the short blurb for release-comms. :white_check_mark:
tim: oncall here — agree manual. note: EU dedicated tenants may be affected; i'll ping account reps. also KV cache warming risk post-rollback (watch token-cost and latency for first 5-10m). recommend staged traffic: 80/20 for 2m then 100%.
elaine: opening a postmortem ticket and adding the failing eval set. also request that we tag telemetry with rollback_reason=canary-p95 so we can correlate automatically.
simon: okay, executing manual rollback window. @deploy-bot run rollback with graceful drain and preserve sessions. please include regions usw2 and usw1 (we observed slight cross-region bleed).
deploy-bot: executing rollback now:
```
/deploy rollback --to v2.14.1 --regions=usw2,usw1 --graceful=true --drain=60s
```
estimated completion ~2m. will pin traffic to v2.14.1 after cutover.
rachel: i'm drafting the customer note and release-note blurb. will post to #release-comms and tag account team once rollback completes.
tim: observability: adding a temporary dashboard for p95 / error_rate / kv_hit and token-cost. will post the link here in 30s. will start the staged 80/20 slice once deploybot confirms.
deploy-bot: rollback completed in 1m45s. traffic pinned to v2.14.1. health checks: p95 returned to baseline (~120ms), error_rate 0.9%. automated-suppression status restored to normal.
simon: excellent. thanks everyone. @elaine please own the RCA and timeline. add a small timeline section in the ticket with timestamps of the decision and execution.
elaine: i'll own it and start the RCA doc. will tag for root-cause hunts and include the eval regressions. :memo:
rachel: sending customer-facing blurb now to #release-comms and emailing account reps. will attach short note to the release notes: "Rollback to v2.14.1 due to canary p95 regression; monitoring shows baseline restored."
simon: closing this thread — good coordination. will follow RCA. :tada:
